doc: Overlay lift sync manifest (#1513, parent #1510). Each entry pairs a source overlay (this repo or shared-frontend) with its shared-services run-half target. scripts/sync-agentconsole-overlay.sh diffs each pair; a drifted or missing target is a finding. An entry with a `skip` string is excluded from sync, with the reason recorded (the reason is surfaced, never silently dropped).

entries.name: capital-underwriting
